facts.text: Arthur, grab a bite from the green room spread and come on out. The folks at home are settled in with their TV dinners.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Murray's words, but he never says it. His real lines on the quote page include 'He's got a book. A book of jokes. Take your time. We've got all night.'

facts.text: Arthur rehearses his entrance in the lounge room.
facts.why: Arthur practises being on Murray's show at home before he is invited on. Close enough for a menu line.

vibe.verdict: The neon talk show club suits the finale, but the dishes and the writing play it safe for such a distinctive film.
